title: Missing AP endpoint for individual status: /users/{username}/statuses/{id}
description: Smallhold has no route for GET /users/{username}/statuses/{id} with Accept: application/activity+json. This endpoint is required for federation — other servers fetch individual posts by AP ID during inbox processing. The AP ID is generated (e.g., https://example.com/users/alice/statuses/123) but the endpoint to serve it doesn't exist. Only the /context sub-endpoint is registered. This means: (1) other servers can't verify posts, (2) conversation backfill fails, (3) the AP attachment[].name field (alt text) can't be verified via federation.
close_reason: Added /users/{username}/statuses/{id} AP endpoint. Returns full Note with attachments (alt text in name field), tags, visibility addressing, content warnings. HTML requests redirect to profile page. Deleted posts return Tombstone.
